% Fires CONTRACT_UNBALANCED_BULLET — the `\resumeItem{...}` body has
% an opening `{` with no matching `}` before the next entry header.
\documentclass[letterpaper,10pt]{article}

\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{\item #1}
\newcommand{\resumeSubheading}[4]{\item \textbf{#1} \hfill \textbf{#2}\\ #3 \hfill #4}

\begin{document}

\section{Experience}
\begin{itemize}
  \resumeSubheading{Engineer}{2024}{Acme}{Remote}
    \begin{itemize}
      \resumeItem{Body that opens a group { and never closes it before the next entry header.
      \resumeItem{Second bullet, but the first never balanced.}
    \end{itemize}
\end{itemize}

\end{document}
